risks: /users endpoint has both GET and POST with no clear distinction; POST is marked placeholder but could be misused
/users/signup and /users/login do not specify auth_required, implying they are public but may leak sensitive data if not secured
PUT /reports/{id}/status auto-assigns to least-loaded TSM without explicit confirmation in docs
No schema definitions for NewUser, LoginRequest, CreateReport are inline; rely on external components which may be missing
GET /users returns all users without auth—potential privacy risk if not intended
